# India’s top 3 boutique hotel chains

[![](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/d8f9c0ce5d442b471db801447c935fe6?s=20&d=mm&r=g)](https://www.aluxurytravelblog.com/author/clad/)By[Chinmoy Lad](https://www.aluxurytravelblog.com/author/clad/)HoursDecember 27, 2016December 18, 2017

The luxury traveler to and within [India](https://www.aluxurytravelblog.com/india-travel-guide/) has long been spoilt for choice in accommodation, with a slew of iconic city and palace hotels, contemporary havelis and wildlife tented camps and lodges operated by the ubiquitous names in the luxury travel industry  Taj Hotels and Palaces, Oberoi, Aman, Leela. Indias renowned sense of warm hospitality has garnered many of the individual properties operated by these brands prestigious awards and acclaim as the worlds best from the worlds top travel publications, as well as voted for by the readers.

Taking heed from the top brands in the travel industry, Indias budding hoteliers have managed to create uniquely boutique chains that have found their own niche in the market. Below are three of Indias top boutique hotel chains:

[**SUJÁN Luxury Camps & Palaces**](https://sujanluxury.com/)

Unarguably the most luxurious name on this list (several of its resorts are Relais&Cheateaux-affiliated), SUJÁN Luxury Camps & Palaces recreates the grandeur of the British Raj with a contemporary touch, replete with all the modern comforts required for a luxury traveler. Four of the five resorts the brand operates are within India (the fifth in Masai Mara, Kenya), with tented camps in Ranthambore ( [Sher-Bagh](https://sujanluxury.com/sher-bagh/index.htm%20)  Indias most famous tiger wildlife sanctuary), Jaisalmer ( [The Serai](https://sujanluxury.com/the-serai/index.htm)  drawing inspiration from royal caravan sites of Rajputana on the outskirts of Jaisalmer) and Jawai Bandh ( [JAWAI](https://sujanluxury.com/jawai/index.htm%20)  a tented camp in the untamed wilderness where leopards roam free), and a palace in the heart of Jaipur ( [Raj Mahal](https://sujanluxury.com/raj-mahal/index.htm)).

![The Serai Jaisalmer - SUJÁN Luxury Camps & Palaces](https://www.aluxurytravelblog.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/sujanluxury.jpg)[**Neemrana**](https://neemranahotels.com/)

Perhaps the most decorated name on this list, [Neemrana](https://neemranahotels.com/) is fairly well known within India, but not as widely recognised in the global hospitality industry just yet, but it certainly ought to be! Neemrana, with its heavy emphasis on protecting and preserving history, has created 23 (and ever growing) unique properties across the landscape of India by taking properties ranging from forts, palaces, havelis, mansions, manors, primarily decrepit or in ruins, that could not make the governments grade for preservation and investing in the preservation, protection and restoration of these stunning monuments that make up Indias history.

![Neemrana Fort Palace](https://www.aluxurytravelblog.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/neemrana1.jpg)

Staying true to its tagline of we dont let history be a bygone, the brands flagship property is, without a doubt, the picturesque [Neemrana Fort-Palace](https://fort-palace.neemranahotels.com/), a 15th century ruin on the Delhi-Jaipur highway, a few hours drive from Delhi. Spreading itself over a hillside overlooking Neemrana, the forts 14 layers cascade down, passing along the way hanging gardens and two pools.

[**The Serai**](https://www.theserai.in/)

Operating four resorts across India, The Serais concept is fairly simple: pick a unique location, and be inspired by the surrounds, which typically consist of nature. Using the environs as a stimulus, theyve managed to create an upscale resorts that are inspired by coffee beans ( [Chikmagalur](https://www.theserai.in/chikmagalur.php)  on the outskirts of one of Indias largest coffee planatations), the jungle ( [Bandipur](https://www.theserai.in/bandipur.php%20)  home to one of the largest populations of endangered tigers), the river ( [Kabini](https://www.theserai.in/kabini.php)  housing Asias largest herd of elephants and more than 300 species of birds), and Andamans ( [Barefoot Havelock](https://www.theserai.in/barefoot.php)   a retreat on a pristine island designed to let you unwind). Uniquely, the brand also runs The Serai Shutterbug, an on-site photography learning experience present at each resort that encourages budding photographers to capture nature in all her naked glory.

# Contact A Luxury Travel Blog

If you have a travel query, please use the search box at the top of the page. From here, you can search more than 12,000 articles that will help you with your travel plans. If on reading an article you still need help or advice, please request this using the comments section at the end of the most relevant post – once published, the author will be alerted to your comment and will be able to respond to you there.

If instead you would like to contact [A Luxury Travel Blog](https://www.aluxurytravelblog.com/) about getting coverage and publicity for your business, please use the following form. Thank you!

"\*" indicates required fields

Email

This field is for validation purposes and should be left unchanged.

Your advertising budget\*

Please note that, in addition to running A Luxury Travel Blog, we also maintain one of the world’s most comprehensive databases of travel content creators, with detailed information on each. If your advertising budget is more than $5k and you are interested in working with a wider audience than just ourselves in order to ‘scale up’ your advertising, please check “Yes”.
